productSpecs.Source-listed details: The new Contour dropper builds on the proven Contour V2.0 platform, with updates focused on making the post lighter, shorter, and more durable for everyday riding. Updated internals now use a combination of brass and additional Teflon keys to better control side-to-side movement, keeping the saddle feeling solid over time and reducing long-term play. Weight has been reduced by roughly 20% compared to the previous version, while the overall post length has been shortened by about 25 mm per size. The shorter stack makes it easier to fit a longer-travel dropper into more frames and rider setups. To simplify the range, we have removed the version number from the title. Although technically a V2.1, it’s now simply called the Contour. If you’re looking for longer travel options with additional features, take a look at the Contour Pro models instead. For servicing and spare parts, the production version is still marked on the lower tube of the post. Specifications Size options, overall length, weight: 30.9 x 120mm, 373mm, 397g 31.6 x 120mm, 372mm, 410g 30.9 x 150mm, 436mm, 450g 31.6 x 150mm, 436mm, 466g 2 Year warranty on physical failure of the post 1 Year warranty on moving parts. Please see our full warranty guide here

productSpecs.Source-listed details: The new Contour Pro dropper builds on the proven Contour V3.0 platform, with updates aimed at improving stability, reducing overall length, and increasing long-term durability for everyday riding. The Pro model features an updated travel-adjust system with an integrated DU bushing, helping the post stay tighter and more stable over time. The internal brass keys have also been revised, now working alongside additional circular flat keys to increase contact surface at top-out and improve rotational stability, keeping the saddle feeling solid even after extended use. Overall post length has been reduced through the use of offset upper clamps and a revised lower mechanism. This shortens the stack height and helps maximise insertion depth, making it easier to fit longer-travel posts into more frames. To simplify the range, we have removed the version number from the title. Although technically a V3.1, it’s now simply called the Contour Pro. If you’re looking for more budget-friendly, shorter-travel options, check out our Contour model instead. Specifications Size options, overall length, weight: 30.9 x 180mm, 491mm, 546g 31.6 x 180mm, 491mm, 563g 2 Year warranty on physical failure of the post 1 Year warranty on moving parts. productSpecs.Source-listed details: The revolutionary 'straight through' coreless design delivers up to 264% more airflow than traditional Presta valves. Featuring a lever-operated ball valve that revolutionises airflow control. No clogging, faster tubeless setup, and adjustable tyre pressures on the go for any terrain and conditions. HIGHLIGHTS Our ball valve construction and integrated lever, you can quickly open and close the valve for effortless airflow control, and even fine tune your pressure whilst you're out riding. They do not use a traditional valve core They have a straight through internal design for maximum airflow, also making sealant application easier – this is up to 245% higher than a traditional valve core, meaning highly efficient inflation. FEATURES Precision CNC machined from 7075 aircraft grade aluminium Coreless, ball valve system opens and closes with integrated lever Stainless steel ball valve with seals and O-rings Maximum air flow efficiency delivers up to 245% higher flow than Presta valves - Dependant on valve version Universal valve head on the hybrid valve is compatible with most screw on and push fit pumps Serviceable design with spanner flats on the head, lever and body 4-way tyre insert air flow base is compatible with most tubeless inserts 4mm machined hex key slot for easy installation / removal Supplied with various rubber bases to optimise fit and seal with multiple rim types

productSpecs.Source-listed details: Our new Tubeless Valves are stronger and lighter. We've done this by upgrading the aluminium grade from 6061 to 7075. We’ve made them even easier to use by introducing a new machined 6 slot channel in the base, these slots allow the tyre to be inflated easier and can be used with most tubeless tyre foam inserts. SEE IT IN ACTION Tubeless just got an upgrade. Introducing the Muc-Off V2 Tubeless Valves. Stronger, lighter and easier than ever to inflate tyres. Available in 10 eye-popping colours, you can add some custom bling to your ride and be sure to provide the perfect seal for your wheels. Take a closer look at what makes the V2 Tubeless Valves better than ever. HIGHLIGHTS Precision machined from aircraft-grade 7075 aluminium Tyre insert air flow system that allows the tyres to be inflated easier Includes Valve Core Removal Tool (integrated into spare alloy cap) DESCRIPTION Introducing our V2 Tubeless Valves with a new Tyre Insert Air Flow System. Featuring 6 slots machined into the base of the valve stem allowing them to be compatible with most tubeless tyre inserts and allow your tubeless sealant fluid and air to flow freely when running tubeless tyre inserts. We’ve also upgraded them to aircraft-grade 7075 aluminium to be lighter and stronger than before! Supplied with 3 sets of different shaped rubber inserts to fit a variety of rim shapes and create the perfect value to rim seal. Choose Your Style Available in 10 eye-popping colours and three sizes - 44mm, 60mm & 80mm - well suited for both MTB, gravel, and road. Why not also mix and match the colour of your Tubeless Valves with contrasting locking rings and caps with our Tubeless Valve Accessory Kits. FEATURES 7075 Aluminium machined valve stem 7075 Aluminium machined cap 4mm machined Allen Key slot for easy installation / removal Includes Valve Core Removal Tool (integrated into spare alloy cap) Supplied with various rubber bases to optimise fit with multiple rim types Assortment of 10 eye-popping anodised colours Available in 3 different sizes - 44mm, 60mm or 80mm Suitable for MTB, gravel, and road Suitable for Presta Valves only HOW TO Muc-Off Tubeless valves will work with most tubeless rims. If you are unsure, please refer to your rim manufacturer's instructions to check which tubeless valves will work for your rims. FITTING INSTRUCTIONS Firstly, remove the valve cap, locking ring and o-ring from the valve stem. Then choose the correct rubber base for your rim type. Rims with a curved rim section will use the circular rubber base. Rims with a square rim section will use the square rubber base. Slot this on down to the bottom of the valve stem. (If you find your rim has a larger valve hole and the smaller circular fitment is too loose, use the larger circular fitment to plug the hole) Now push the valve stem into the hole in the rim and push it right the way though. Then place the rubber 0-ring onto the valve stem and slide it all the way down until it meets the rim. Screw the locking ring onto the valve stem and tighten down above the o-ring. This sandwiches between the locking ring and the rim. Push firmly down on the valve base inside the rim as you tighten the locking ring. Keep pushing until the locking rick is hand tight and the rubber o-ring squashes out. This way you know you've created a good air tight seal. TIP - don't over tighten as this can cause leaking. Finish by screwing on your preferred valve cap. Use the valve core removal tool (integrated into spare alloy cap) to remove the core and fill with no puncture hassle tubeless sealant and inflate! Job Done. WHAT'S INCLUDED? 2x 7075 aluminium tubeless Presta valves 2x Valve caps 2x Locking nuts 1x Valve core removal tool (doubles as a spare valve cap) 3 x Pairs of rubber bases for size choice

(If you find your rim has a larger valve hole and the smaller circular fitment is too loose, use the larger circular fitment to plug the hole) Now push the valve stem into the hole in the rim and push it right the way though. Then place the rubber 0-ring onto the valve stem and slide it all the way down until it meets the rim. Screw the locking ring onto the valve stem and tighten down above the o-ring. This sandwiches between the locking ring and the rim. Push firmly down on the valve base inside the rim as you tighten the locking ring. Keep pushing until the locking rick is hand tight and the rubber o-ring squashes out. This way you know you've created a good air tight seal. TIP - don't over tighten as this can cause leaking. Finish by screwing on your preferred valve cap. Use the valve core removal tool (integrated into spare alloy cap) to remove the core and fill with no puncture hassle tubeless sealant and inflate! stores.name: SRAM
stores.role: Manufacturer verification of T-Type/UDH, cassette XD and PG1210 splined interfaces; no foreign-currency prices used

drives.method: Reviewed 12 distinct MTB drivetrain/upgrade package offers and 10 distinct chain models via actual public retailer product feeds on 19 October 2026. Kept package contents and missing essentials explicit. Used manufacturer pages only for exact additional compatibility evidence. No colour duplicates, no computed bundle credits, no RCS inventory claims, no performance ratings. Supplied-chain mass assigned only when the measured link-count basis matches the exact supplied variant. Downloaded each actual source product photograph locally.
exclusions: No claim to cover all South African retailers or all products.
SRAM NX chain handle returned 404; current S100 classic Eagle chain retained instead.
Classic Eagle, Road Flattop and MTB T-Type are distinct; Road Flattop chains are excluded from this MTB set.
Shimano SLX/XT/XTR default mechanical upgrade-kit cassette ranges are not resolved from generic source family descriptions; supplier must confirm exact cassette before fitting.
Wireless shift-only upgrade kits do not include cassette, chain, crankset, chainring or BB. They must not complete a bike by themselves.
All listed kit prices are package prices; an included chain cannot create an independent credit or an assumed stand-alone price.
No total kit masses invented from individual component averages. XTR chain average and X0/XXSL 114-link engineering-estimate masses are withheld from supplied/installed totals.
XXSL T-Type chain source explicitly excludes E-MTB use.
No brake pair or BB included unless actually listed; drivetrain package photographs are not proof of extras.

contact.method: Reviewed actual public South African product JSON and exact priced variants on 19 October 2026. Brake pairs preserve both ends; cockpit bundles sum separately priced bar and stem. Fixed reviewed SKUs avoid invented option combinations. Source-listed availability is an observation, not RCS stock. Partial masses and uncertain remote inclusion remain explicit.
exclusions: SRAM DB4 generic set: exact left and right lever/caliper listings used instead to make both ends explicit.
Satori Sorata Lite: variant length 400 mm conflicts with 390 mm description and description discusses suspension rather than a clear dropper mechanism.
Race Face Turbine R: priced 10 mm rise conflicts with description referring to 20 mm rise; excluded.
OneUp pre-bundled cockpit: package contents and interfaces not fully described; used separately priced, dimensioned bar/stem sources.
No comfort, braking power, stiffness or speed scores were inferred from retailer marketing.

expansion.method: Actual public SA product/variant feeds and ZAR cart currency checked. Exact source SKUs retained. Three reversible SRAM brake pairs count two single units; wheelsets and single tyres retain physical scope. Colour offers are merged where the same model is identified. Generic casing/compound/TR and source mass claims are not borrowed into exact packages. Missing package contents stay unresolved. No finance repayment is a selling price.
